source.title: Some open problems in geometric function theory in several complex variables

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL for document 5210712. Direct fetching of https://zbmath.org/5210712 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the page itself was not a readable primary source.

Failure mode: metadata_only after blocked_or_challenged resolver access. Queried the zbMATH Open API for document 5210712 and confirmed exact metadata: Zbl identifier 1130.32005, author Sheng Gong, title Some open problems in geometric function theory in several complex variables, pages 85-96, published in the 2005 Kyushu University Press proceedings. The API record exposed no full-text links, and its review text was not used as extraction evidence.

Inspected the Kyushu University Press page https://kup.or.jp/en/booklist/ns/899.html. It confirms the proceedings volume and lists item 10 with the exact article title and author, but it is only a catalog/table-of-contents page and does not contain the article text or problem statements.

Queried Crossref and OpenAlex by exact title, author, and year. Crossref returned related or different Sheng Gong works, and OpenAlex exact-title search returned no matching work. Exact-work web searches for the exact title, the title plus author/PDF, and the title plus pages 85-96 produced only publisher metadata or different works, so no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source was recovered within the bounded pass.

Mapping was skipped because no readable primary PDF or HTML full-text artifact was available. Search snippets, resolver metadata, API review text, and publisher table-of-contents text were not treated as technical sources for extracting questions.
Saved JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/5210712.json and outputs/latest.json.
